title: Stars of a wooden panel from medieval Sicily
subtitle: British Museum, wooden panel from Sicily

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s BM1 drawing, its corners snapped to exact values. We devised the construction: every line touches a small circle round O, A, C or K1, all of one radius, found by halving the length ON. The drawing gives no steps.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The comparison with the drawing checks the finished lines, not how the design was first laid out. The panel itself was not checked: no free photo of it was found.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data207/BM1: exhibit at the British Museum
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: The design was read from his drawing, made from a photo by Dirk Booms of a wooden panel from medieval Sicily (1125–1195) in the British Museum. The construction is ours.

given.O: The centre of a small sharp star.
given.A: The centre of a large star, halfway to the side of the square tile.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. These lines make the square cell, with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1, a corner of the cell. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre K1 through A. It crosses the line from O to K1 at G. Draw a vertical line through G. It crosses the horizontal line at N.
Draw a circle with centre O through N. Draw a circle with centre N through O. They cross at P and Q. Draw a straight line through P and Q. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

The line through P and Q crosses the horizontal line at S. It crosses the line from O to K1 at H. Draw a circle with centre O through H. It crosses the horizontal line at T. Draw a straight line through A and C. Draw a line through T parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The lines make the star at O.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line through P and Q crosses the horizontal line at S. It crosses the line from O to K1 at H. Draw a circle with centre O through H. It crosses the horizontal line at T. Draw a line through T at 45° to the horizontal line. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The lines make the star at O.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre O through S. Draw a circle with centre A and the same radius. It crosses the horizontal line at U, near O. Draw a vertical line through U. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Draw a circle with centre A and the same radius as the circle through T. It crosses the horizontal line at W, beyond A. Draw a line through W parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre A and the same radius as the circle through T. It crosses the horizontal line at W, beyond A. Draw a line through W parallel to the line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

steps.text: Draw a circle with centre K1 and the same radius as the circle through T. It crosses the vertical line through A at Z, below K1. Draw a line through Z parallel to line AC. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a circle with centre K1 and the same radius as the circle through T. It crosses the vertical line through A at Z, below K1. Draw a line through Z parallel to the line through T. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

steps.text: Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the small star at O, the large stars round A, B, C and D, and the lines between them. They close the squares and the eight-sided pieces.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square cell side by side. Small and large stars take turns along every row.
